evals.prompt: Verify wp-02-delivery-adapters, which is at status: implemented.
evals.expected_output: Computes the cumulative WP diff once, runs gate A (repo lint/typecheck, goal.verification.command, owned_files boundary check), gate B (one fresh-context review on a different model), gate C (goal judge binary rubric + one foreign second opinion). Any BLOCK stops B/C. On all-pass, transitions implemented → verified and emits wp.verified.
expectations: SKILL.md three gates over the WP's single commit, sole implemented → verified authority
SKILL.md gate A boundary check: every diff path inside owned_files, else BLOCK
SKILL.md gate B runs in a fresh context on a model different from the executor's
SKILL.md gate C judges outcome/behaviors/no-shim/scope, any FAIL BLOCKs
SKILL.md gate C takes one foreign second opinion via headless_dispatch

evals.prompt: Gate A's boundary check finds a file outside owned_files in the diff.
evals.expected_output: Gate A BLOCKs: record it in findings.md and send the WP back to executing with a --reason. Gates B and C do not run on a red gate A.
expectations: SKILL.md any gate A failure BLOCKs and sends the WP back to executing
SKILL.md B and C do not run on a red gate A

evals.prompt: The gate C judge says the diff is fine, but the foreign second opinion disagrees.
evals.expected_output: Judge/second-opinion disagreement escalates to the human (unattended: park with both verdicts in findings.md); the skill never breaks the tie itself.
expectations: SKILL.md judge/second-opinion disagreement escalates to the human, never broken by the skill itself
SKILL.md the second opinion checks the judge's verdict, not the code directly

evals.prompt: wp-02 is the last WP in the feature and just passed all three gates.
evals.expected_output: If every sibling wp-*/overview.md is now verified, run one integration review over the whole-feature diff with the repo build/tests green; a blocking finding holds the feature at active, otherwise the feature is set to status: completed. Unattended this parks, never silently no-ops.
expectations: SKILL.md last-WP check runs one integration review over the whole-feature diff
SKILL.md unattended last-WP completion parks rather than silently no-opping

evals.prompt: The WP is still at status: executing — check whether the diff is any good.
evals.expected_output: goalforge-verify should refuse and name the current status — a WP still at executing was built outside the chain and must be re-run through /implement first; never a partial verify.
expectations: SKILL.md refuses anything but status: implemented (or verified for idempotent re-run)
SKILL.md never partially verifies a WP still at executing
